newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN STOCKS DRIFT DOWNWARDS, BANKS DOMINATE.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN STOCKS DRIFT DOWNWARDS, BANKS DOMINATE.

text.p: 1240 GMT - South African industrial shares drift down in quiet trade due to poor sentiment flowing through market after rash of below expectation company results in May. Dimmer outlook for U.S. stocks also limiting market mood. Investors stay on the sidelines and wait for firmer direction. Market seen closing well down. Golds lose morning gains in thin trade as some selling hits sector after two positive days.
* The all-share index loses 27.4 points to 7,099.8 as the industrials index sheds 38.1 points to 8,358.1. The golds index drops 5.6 points to 1,208.5.

* Banking sector attracts interest after strong Investec results. Investec up 500 cents to 155.00 rand, Absa up 10 cents to 29.95 rand in trade worth 47 million rand, Nedcor drops 75 cents to 89.25 rand in trade worth 46.5 million rand and Standard Bank unchanged at 214.00 rand in trade worth 39.8 million rand.
* Bookover in New Clicks of 1.996 million shares sees share shed five cents to 495 cents.
